what: The Palace Hotel (1 Nguyễn Trãi), across from the park of Bãi Trước near the Grand Hotel: a pink tower of 8 storeys with the letters PALACE HOTEL on its roof, a front block of 6 storeys with brick panels, and a porch on Nguyễn Trãi (report 0026, D-0026-10)

options.name: khach_san_palace
sources: The Palace Hotel of Vũng Tàu (1 Nguyễn Trãi). Plan: OpenStreetMap way 791795130 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Look: photos of 2014 (trungydang, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0), 2018 (Flickr) and 2022 (mia.vn).

sources.author: Flickr user 10598985@N07
sources.shows: From the pool on the north side: the tower of 8 storeys (a ground storey and 7 rows of windows, the boxes of air conditioners on its north face), the front block of 6 storeys with balconies and brick panels at its west corner, a restaurant with a terrace in front of it, a low wing of 2 storeys with brick panels on the left; pink walls; on the roof of the tower the letters PALACE (navy) and HOTEL (red) with a blue sign in the shape of a diamond.

sources.date: 2014-04-09 or before (the first upload to Panoramio)
sources.author: trungydang
sources.shows: From Nguyễn Trãi near Quang Trung, to the north-east: the front block of 6 storeys (its west face with two bays of brick panels, the column of the stair between them, a loggia at the top storey under a frame with a pergola), the tower of 8 storeys behind it with the letters PALACE HOTEL (blue) and a sign in the shape of a diamond on its roof, balconies on its west face and at the west end of its south face, the curved porch with columns and its fascia on the corner, a lower block at the east end; pale pink walls.

sources.date: on or before 2022-05-01 (the time in the name of the file)
sources.author: MIA.vn
sources.shows: The porch from the south-west: the curved fascia over pairs of columns, a canopy of glass, the front block with brick panels and balconies on its south face and a pergola on its top, the tower with balconies and the letters PALACE (navy) HOTEL (red) on its roof; pink walls, the same as in 2014 and 2018.

sources.date: on or before 2022-05-01 (the time in the name of the file)
sources.author: MIA.vn
sources.shows: The pool, the low wing of 2 storeys on the left, the tower and the front block with balconies, as in the photo of 2018.

sources.author: Stan Middleton (Flickr aodcurator)
sources.shows: The top of the hotel over the trees, behind the old water tower: pale pink walls, the letters PALACE (blue) HOTEL (red) and a sign in the shape of a diamond on the roof.

sources.date: unknown (Esri does not give the date of this image)
sources.license: Esri World Imagery terms of use (not open)
sources.author: Esri and its providers
sources.shows: From above (tiles of zoom 19 round the hotel): the roof of the front block with a pergola at the west end of the outline of way 791795130, the curved canopy of glass of the porch at its south-west corner, the taller tower east of it (its shadow falls on the roof of the front block), a lower block at the east end, the pool north of the front block, and the large low hall of way 791795129 east of the pool.

plan.value: 60.4 m along Nguyễn Trãi (with the porch), 31 to 37 m deep
plan.source: The outline of OpenStreetMap (way 791795130; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), simplified: its north side is one straight line, and the notch of its north side is left out.

parts.value: front block 23.4 m (west), tower 19 m, east block 18 m; the porch 18 m wide and 10 m deep in the corner of the front block and the tower
parts.source: The image from above (Esri, date unknown): the roof with the pergola is at the west end, the canopy of the porch at the south-west corner (as the curve of the outline of OSM), the shadow of the taller part falls on the roof of the front block. The widths are estimates from that image (no dated photo from above).

storeys_tower.source: Photo 0 (2018): the column of the stair on the north face of the tower has 7 rows of windows over the ground storey. Photo 1 (2014): 6 rows over the porch and 2 storeys under its fascia.

storeys_front_block.source: Photo 1 (2014): 3 storeys of brick panels and the loggia over the 2 storeys under the fascia of the porch, the same rows as the 4th to the 6th storeys of the tower; photo 0 (2018): the balconies of the front block stop 2 storeys under the top of the tower.

storeys_east_block.source: Photo 1 (2014) and photo 2 (2022): the block at the east end is 2 storeys lower than the tower in both, so it was so in 2019 (report 0026, Q17, rule 1).

storey.source: estimate (no source): no person or car is at the face of the building in a photo of 2017 to 2021.

ground_storey.source: estimate (no source): photo 1 (2014) gives at least 4.3 m from the street to the fascia of the porch at the scale of the car in front of it (1.5 m high), but the car is nearer than the porch. A band of 1.0 m over it.

height.source: From the storeys and the storey: the roof of the tower at 27.3 m, its parapet 1.0 m (estimate (no source)); the front block and the east block 21.9 m.

porch.value: 18 m wide, 10 m deep, 8.2 m high, 6 columns, a fascia of 1.3 m
porch.source: Photos 1 (2014) and 2 (2022) show the same porch: a curved fascia with the gold letters PALACE HOTEL over 2 pairs of columns and 2 single columns, at the top of the first storey (the 3 storeys of brick panels start over it), and a canopy on steel rods. So the porch was so in 2019 (Q17, rule 1). The canopy is blue with a blue banner in 2014 and clear glass in 2022: its look in 2019 is Check (the model has no canopy). The model has a straight fascia, not curved. Its width, depth and height are estimates from the outline and the photos.

brick_panels.value: 2 bays of 8.0 m with 3 storeys of brick each, a column of the stair of 1.8 m between them, two small windows in the top row of each bay
brick_panels.source: Photos 1 (2014) and 2 (2022): the west face of the front block, two bays of 3 storeys with the column of the stair between them (the same in both: rule 1). The color is not the same: a light tan in photo 1 and orange red brick in photo 2; photo 0 (2018) shows the brick at the north-west corner (#a3796f), so the color comes from photo 0 (rule 2). The widths: estimates from the photos (the face is 21.3 m on the outline).

letters.value: PALACE 1.5 m high (navy #1f2f6e), HOTEL 0.9 m high (red #b3261e), on the west edge of the roof of the tower
letters.source: Photo 0 (2018): PALA in navy and HO in red on the roof; photos 1 (2014) and 2 (2022) the whole name. The two photos do not agree on the color of HOTEL (blue in photo 1, red in photo 2); photo 0 (2018) shows red, so the colors come from photo 0 (rule 2). The heights: in photo 1 the letters of PALACE are 0.45 of a storey of the tower and those of HOTEL 0.28. The letters of the building blueprint are wider than the real ones. The sign in the shape of a diamond (blue in photos 0 and 1) is not on the model.

colors.source: Photo 0 (2018), medians: the sunlit west face of the tower #c89ca1, the wall of the front block #c79e9d, the brick panel at the corner #a3796f, the rails #393e3f. The trim (piers and bands) is a lighter pink in photos 0 to 2.

balconies.value: loggias on the south face of the tower (4 bays), on the south end of its west face (2 bays), on the south face of the front block (3 bays) and on its north face (4 bays); one balcony over the other at the west end of the south face of the tower
balconies.source: Photos 0 (2018: the north face of the front block), 1 (2014) and 2 (2022: the south faces).

windows_north_east.value: 5 windows a storey with air conditioners on the north face of the tower, 8 on its east face, 3 on the north face of the east block
windows_north_east.source: Photo 0 (2018): windows and boxes of air conditioners on the north face of the tower. The counts are estimates (no source).

looks.seen: A preview in my workspace, not a build of the factory: the factory answers HTTP 503 (memory) when it places this order, so I made the edits of the rule (World.Town.Building, ported to Python) into voxels of 0.2 m and rendered them with tools/world/look.gd (build/look/khach_san_palace_preview_mid.png and, with the model turned 90 degrees so that the views come from the west and the south-west, _turn90.png). The porch was a thin slab on six thin columns of the rule; photos 1 and 2 show a high fascia and thick columns. The letters PALACE HOTEL read correctly from the west (the park) and from the south-west (the corner of Nguyễn Trãi and Quang Trung); the side view of the sheet comes from the east, behind the sign, so it shows their back.
looks.changed: A fascia of 1.3 m on the front of the porch, six columns of 0.35 m in place of the columns of the rule, the balconies one over the other at the west end of the south face of the tower, the slab of the porch in the color of the trim.

looks.seen: A preview in my workspace, not a build of the factory: the factory answers HTTP 503 (memory) when it places this order, so I made the edits of the rule (World.Town.Building, ported to Python) into voxels of 0.2 m and rendered them with tools/world/look.gd (build/look/khach_san_palace_preview_mid.png and _turn90.png). Next to photos 0 (2018), 1 (2014) and 2 (2022): the front block of 6 storeys with two bays of brick panels, the stair column, the loggia of its top storey and the pergola; the tower 2 storeys higher with 8 windows a storey over the front block; the letters PALACE (navy) HOTEL (red) on the west edge of its roof face the park and read correctly from the west and the south-west, as the sign in the photos; the porch in the corner of the front block and the tower. Still different: the fascia of the porch is straight (curved in the photos) and has no canopy of glass, the frame over the top of the front block is not there, the stacked balconies on the north side are not there.

A preview in my workspace, not a build of the factory: the factory answers HTTP 503 (memory) when it places this order, so I made the edits of the rule (World.Town.Building, ported to Python) into voxels of 0.12 m and rendered them with tools/world/look.gd (build/look/khach_san_palace_preview_near.png and _turn90.png). The rail panels of the loggias show; the rest is as at the mid level.

uses: Plan 0026, D-0026-10: the Palace Hotel across from the park, on its OSM outline (way 791795130, on Nguyễn Trãi); its place is in data/world/places/bai_truoc.json.
status_note: Check. The photos of 2014 (photo 1) and of 2022 (photo 2) show the same porch, the same faces of the front block (brick bays, the column of the stair, the loggia and the pergola at the top), the same balconies of the tower and the east block 2 storeys lower: that was the look in 2019 (report 0026, Q17, rule 1). Photo 0 (2018) shows the tower, the front block, the letters and the pink walls (rule 2). They do not agree on: the color of HOTEL on the roof and of the brick panels (photo 0 of 2018 gives both), and the canopy of the porch (blue in 2014, clear glass in 2022; the model has none). Still Check: the height of a storey (3.2 m) and of the ground storey (4.2 m) are estimates (no source): the car in front of the porch in photo 1 is nearer than the porch, and no photo has a person or a car at the face. The model also differs from both photos: the fascia of the porch is straight (curved in the photos), and the porch has no canopy. No look of the model of the factory: the factory stops at this order (HTTP 503); the looks below are of a preview in my workspace. I grow the area to the lot (Q15).
